reserveReview.rationale: At finalized Solana slot 468852221 (block time 2026-11-13T08:02:03Z; observed 2026-11-13T08:02:03.380453Z), one getMultipleAccounts response covered the complete reviewed account inventory, including ONYC pair/vault/mint/oracle, both LST headers and vaults, other active exogenous vaults, USDC and hyUSD supply. Same-slot fully verified Pyth observations and LST SOL conversions value gross collateral at $29,910,280.211256653. Pool liabilities total 21,753,934.698444 hyUSD against mint supply 21,753,912.486178, a 22.212266 excess within the owner-approved max(50 hyUSD, supply times 0.000001) tolerance. The same fixed excess was observed on November 12/13; its origin is not established. All pause flags are clear; PST and WETH candidate accounts returned null. ONYC vault holds 0.186715986 units at oracle price $1.16547940. Exact pair/mint/vault/oracle/feed identities match the pinned SDK and prior PDA verification. The ONYC holding links to tracked onyc-onre as collateral, classified as a high-risk fund share; it establishes no new custody, look-through or redemption guarantee. Runtime pricing remains the existing DefiLlama CoinGecko ONYC path; these curated weights use the census Pyth observations. Scoped identity research on 2026-11-10 identifies the ZEC parties only. The exact Hylo SDK mint A7bdiYdS5GjqGFtxf17ppRHtDKPkkRqbKtR27dxvQXaS maps to zec.omft.near in omni.bridge.near get_token_id, and get_token_address(Sol, zec.omft.near) returns that mint, at NEAR height 223940163, block C1zxbbZUnfPbNGFTccw5SCbBbHHsa4s35bMCWxwJKZCw (2026-11-10T16:18:29.910769385Z). The pinned Near One SDK calls zec.omft.near the PoA version; current NEAR Intents docs name Near One for Omni Bridge, while the October 7 terms name Intents Technology Limited as PoA developer/operator. The combined identity names serial bridge counterparties, without asserting a legal redemption guarantee, independent custodians or a final-cash deadline.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Single finalized Solana account census with SDK v2.0.5 layouts, reviewed vault identities, current LST SOL conversions, same-slot fully verified Pyth SOL/USD, BTC/USD, HYPE/USD, ZEC/USD, ONYC/USD and USDC/USD prices, and bounded pool-liability reconciliation to the hyUSD mint
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reviewed SDK inventory contains two LST headers, cbBTC/HYPE/ZEC/ONYC exogenous pools and USDC; PST and WETH candidates returned null at the capture slot. ZEC serial bridge parties retain the scoped November 10 identity review; underlying custody and redemption guarantees remain unverified. ONYC links only the measured fund-share holding to onyc-onre, without inferring reciprocal backing. The fixed 22.212266 hyUSD liability excess has no established origin.
